fair_value_reason: P/E leg: $7.80 pro forma adjusted NTM EPS x 17.5x (reconciled NTM peer median, no premium) = $136.5. EV/EBITDA leg: ~$1.60B pro forma NTM EBITDA (CHRW ~$1.22B, RXO ~$0.20B, ~$0.18B synergies) x 14.0x = $22.4B, less ~$4.45B net debt, over 131.85M shares = $136.1. 14x is the multiple implied by the P/E leg; the peer EV/EBITDA data is trailing only. Blend ~$136.3, less ~$0.75/share expected uninsured Lipe cost, gives ~$135.5. That is down from my round-1 $142 because my $8.1 EPS mixed buyback-assisted EPS with a no-buyback share count, and my $4.2B net debt ignored weak 2026 cash conversion. It is within $1 of the agents' $136.6 mean.
supervisor_summary: Round 2 converged: fair values $131-140 (mean $136.6), all below my round-1 $142. Three agents independently found what I got wrong: my $8.1 pro forma EPS double counted buybacks, and my $4.2B net debt was too low. Reconciled, CHRW is worth ~$135.5 at the horizon: $7.80 pro forma NTM EPS at the 17.5x NTM peer median, $4.45B net debt and $0.75/sh Lipe. That is about where it trades today. The 2.9x leverage figure is in the deal deck itself (synergy-inclusive), the peer sets now agree on 10 names, and no agent uses an unjustified premium. The ladder stays at the agents' mean with low confidence; the next tests are the Q3 print (~80% before Nov 4) and the Lipe ruling (likely by early December).
key_drivers: Deal math (primary exhibits): ~15.0M new shares, 131.85M pro forma; ~$3.0B cash consideration plus $0.49B RXO net debt refinanced; 2.9x net debt / LTM EBITDA at close INCLUDING full $300M synergies (EX-99.2 slide 12 footnote), ~3.6x unsynergized; net debt ~$4.45B at Oct-2027; buybacks paused to the 1.75-2.25x target by YE2028.

Pro forma adjusted NTM EPS ~$7.80 at the horizon, after removing the ~4%/yr buyback lift in consensus ($432M bought in H1-2026) and charging deal interest; synergy timing is the swing factor (each $100M pre-tax is ~$0.58/share).
Valuation: 10-peer NTM median 17.5x (ex-UPS, ex-LTL). CHRW standalone trades at 19.65x NTM. 17.5-18x on $7.80 gives $136-140; the asset-light premium is offset by leverage until 2028.
Cash conversion and credit: H1-2026 operating cash flow of $104.5M (vs $333.7M) slows deleveraging; S&P BBB+ with a negative outlook while the $4.5B committed financing is termed out.
Lipe: the borrowed-employee finding makes joint-and-several liability for $604M plausible; expected uninsured cost is ~$0.75/share, and the ruling is likely by early December.
